description: European natural gas storage levels from GIE AGSI+: how full EU gas storage is (fill % of working gas volume), gas in storage in TWh, daily injection and withdrawal, trend, and the gas day — for the whole EU, one country (e.g. Germany "DE", Italy "IT"), one storage operator or one facility. Omit dates for the latest gas day; pass from/to for a daily series. Requires a free GIE API key as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your GIE API key (sent as the x-key header). Required: GIE refuses storage and LNG level calls without it. Register free at https://agsi.gie.eu/account.

company.description: Storage operator EIC code (operator_eic from gie_storage_facilities). Needs country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "DE", "IT", "NL", "FR". Omit or pass "EU" for the EU aggregate.

days.description: Max gas days to return (1-300). Default 1 with no dates (latest day), 30 with dates.

facility.description: Storage facility EIC code (facility eic from gie_storage_facilities). Needs country and company.

name: gie_gas_storage
title: Gie Gas Storage
